...We can damage even the large <Jevilun>.@Whether we can wipe them out on our own...
...is hard to say, now that they've come here.
Sean
Captain, there's a <Thorn> in the combat area.@The Granteed should stand by aboard the ship.
Yes, I agree.
(If they can use that trick of theirs@to take the Granteed from inside the ship,@it would mean our defeat.)
(If they wanted to, they could plant a large@bomb or the like aboard and detonate it.)
(If neither Seldoa nor Julian was there@when <Ashurey Kreuzer> was attacked...)
(Ally, were you also...?)
The Bellzelute...@So the Granteed hasn't come out.
(If that's the truth, then I...)
Katia
Are you going to contact the gray Thorn too?
Yes, to find out the truth about the attack@on <Ashurey>. It concerns you as well.@You have a problem with that?
No, it's just that you seemed@sort of hesitant, Calvina.
...You don't need to worry about me.
Tenia
Hey, Calvina.@Are you going to contact the gray Thorn too?
No, I was just asking to be sure.
(...Is she saying I'm hesitating?)
Melua
Um...@Are you going to contact the gray Thorn too...?
No, it's just... I'm worried about you, Calvina.
...Mind your own business.
Hey, over there! There's a big Lamaris!
He's right...!
Until now, they've only appeared in front of us...
Is something we and they have in common@prompting the Lamaris to merge...?
Either way, the Lamaris must be annihilated.@Gilliam, do you think that Thorn will use that trick?
I think it's unlikely.@When it appeared at Izu before, it didn't use it@even with the Granteed right in front of it.
Still, we can't let our guard down.@We don't know why they're attacking the Lamaris.
They're enemies, so we defeat them. Simple as that.
If we hadn't come, I wonder if those folks@meant to exterminate the Lamaris here.
Their aim is most likely data collection@or capturing samples, I'd think...
If so, the Lamaris are an unknown@to them as well.
Either way, both are enemies we must eliminate.@All units, commence attack!
Raji, I'm counting on you for data on the gray Thorn.
Raji
Yes, I understand.
Ganjar Squad and I will keep attacking the@large Jevilun while gathering data. The rest of@you, hold off the Steel Dragons for a while.
Squire
Yes, ma'am!
(The Bellzelute... Will she come after me?)
(I have to latch onto that Thorn, no matter what...!)
I can latch on now!
I can latch onto the Thorn now!
(...So she came after all.)
I know you can hear me! Who are you?!
...It's me, Karin.
Wh-Why do you know that name?!
Huh?! How does he know that name?!
What...?! How does he know that name...
Th-That voice calling me Karin...@Ally...?!
That's right.
S-So you're just like Julian...?@Wh-Was it you at Izu too...?
...Yeah.
I don't understand... I don't understand!@Tell me, please!@What is going on?!
What's happening?!@I don't understand! Please, tell me!@Why are you piloting that thing?!
Because this Raftclans belongs to me...@Al-Van Ranks.
No... That's a lie, I don't want this!@Come on, stop with the sick joke!@Was it you who attacked Ashurey back then?!
You killed everyone?! That's a lie, right?!@Tell me it's a lie, Ally!!
...Karin, I wanted you to go on@living somewhere else.
But you joined the Steel Dragons@with the Bellzelute and appeared before me.
Karin, will you hand over that unit?@With that deed to your credit, I'll make@my people accept you among us.
Ugh... Why... Why...!
If you wish, I won't kill the girl riding with you.
Karin,@won't you come with me... to the Fury?
The Fury...?
Otherwise, I will have to destroy@the Bellzelute and kill you both.
Calvina, don't listen to him!@He's the reason Mom and Dad and everyone...!
I don't want you going with him!@Because of him, Mom and Dad and everyone...!
No, Calvina.@You mustn't listen to him.@Because of him, Mom and Dad and everyone...
...give you.
Karin?
I'll never forgive you. You killed everyone and@tried to kill me too. I thought you'd died@with everyone else that day.
I could never forget you.@But I was wrong. You killed everyone.@You were deceiving me from the very start.
It was all a lie, every bit of it. Wasn't it?@I trusted you... all this time!
Karin, I...
Don't you dare call me that name!!
I'll never forgive you!@And I won't let you have this Bellzelute!
I don't care who you are or what you're after!@I won't let you have your way ever again!
I see...@All units, you've held them off long enough.@Withdraw from the combat area at once.
Running away?!
Karin, I'll give you time to think.
Don't mess with me!!
When we next meet, I'll hear your answer.@...Farewell.
Wait!!
Calvina, where are you going?!@There are still Lamaris in the combat area!
Ngh...!
Calvina...
Calvina...
(Ally... no, Al-Van...@You said you'd destroy the Bellzelute.)
(I'll be waiting.@The next time we meet, I'll kill you myself...!)
(...So the gray Thorn didn't use that trick after all.@Why not?)
Eleve 1 to all units!@Sweep the Lamaris from the combat area!
Captain, the Lamaris in the combat area@have been annihilated.
This ship will hold TD Hovering at its position.@All units, maintain strict all-around watch.
I wonder if we managed to purify@the Lamaris here in Taipei too.
I think it's probably fine.
Yeah, it went more smoothly@than in Shinjuku or Osaka...
Maybe it was thanks to the Thorn, believe it or not.
Because they made contact with the Lamaris first?
Don't be ridiculous!
That man... those people would never...!
(Jeez. Even if the Lamaris are handled,@the real problem is...)
Calvina Coulange.@After the operation, report to me with Katia.
Calvina Coulange.@After the operation, report to me@with Festenia.
Calvina Coulange.@After the operation, report to me with Melua.
...Rog...er.
Gaw-La Furia - Interior
...During combat, several <Jevilun> fused@and grew huge. It's the same phenomenon that@occurred when the <Steel Dragons> faced them.
Gu-Landon
What we have in common with them...@would be the Cytron Systems of@the Granteed and the Bellzelute.
Yes. I surmise that a system involving the@human mind and thoughts is affecting@the Jevilun.
Then we too can exterminate them...
Karo-Ran
Incidentally, Al-Van.@During your mission, you encountered the Granteed@and the Bellzelute. Why did you let them go?
Her Highness ordered us not to fight@the Earthlings needlessly.
Hmph... You're tipped as the next Knight Commander,@so I thought you could handle two tasks. Did I@overrate you? Or can you not dispose of the fake?
Then allow me to say this.@Our most urgent task is to retake the Throne@Unit. And rather than achieve it by force...
...would it not be better to persuade@its pilot to come over to our side?
Why must we hold talks with Earthlings?
Only Her Highness can make the Throne Unit a@'key.' Should something befall the <Gate of Voda>,@we cannot send her into battle alone.
I believe we need one of Shune's blood...@one who will fight as Her Highness's sword.
It is that very bloodline that is the problem.
Then whom do you intend@to make the Throne Unit's pilot?
To unleash the 'key's' power, Her Highness@need only ride it alone. The Throne Unit cannot@fight, but we Knights will protect her.
But...
This proposal of yours...@I suspect you have another reason.@One tied not to the Throne Unit, but to the fake.
Taiwan - Taipei District
Steel Dragons
Hiryu Custom - Briefing Room
Lieutenant Calvina.@You seem to have exchanged a private transmission@with the gray <Thorn>'s pilot. What did you discuss?
As you probably know,@we can forcibly analyze your conversation.
(I was talking with the enemy.@Of course they'd suspect me...)
But before that, tell us of your own will.@In front of the captain and the rest of us.
...I have no intention of hiding it.@The one piloting the gray Thorn@was Alistair Lynx...
Though just now,@he called himself Al-Van Ranks.
Alistair Lynx...@That name was on the list of presumed dead@from the <Ashurey Kreuzer> attack.
Yes... Yes, that's right!@That's what I thought too!@And yet he...!
Calm yourself, Lieutenant.
He was someone you knew well, then.
Yes. Alistair Lynx was on@the Bellzelute's development staff.
(Doesn't look like he was just an acquaintance, though.)
Katia,@have you ever met Alistair Lynx?
I think I heard the name after I went@to Ashurey Kreuzer... but I've never@actually met him.
Tenia,@have you ever met Alistair Lynx?
Nope. I think I heard the name@before I got on the Bellzelute,@but I've never met him.
Melua,@have you ever met Alistair Lynx?
I heard the name a few times after I went@to Ashurey Kreuzer... but I've never@actually met him.
...If I recall, the one that attacked@Ashurey Kreuzer was the gray Thorn.
Yes, according to the reports.
He called his unit@the 'Raftclans'...
So that's its official name.
In other words, Alistair Lynx destroyed@the very company he belonged to.@What was his reason?
How should I know something like that?!
You... That's quite enough.
Calvina... Right now, nobody could blame us@for sayin' you're in league with the enemy.
If you suspect me, go right ahead.@But you know what? I was deceived too.@If you can't trust me, use truth serum or whatever.
...Well, the likelihood of Lieutenant Calvina@being a mole is low.
Yes... Being interrogated right after the fact@disqualifies her as a spy or an operative.
...He told me...@to come to the 'Fury.'
The Fury... A place name?
In the Old Calendar era, there was a British@piston-engine aircraft by that name.
From the nuance, it sounded like the name@of the unit or faction that man belongs to...
An alien word that sounds@the same as one in an Earth language...
Like the <Golaikunru>, could the Fury@be a faction of the <Zovorg>?
We can't say anything at this point.
Alistair Lynx of Ashurey Kreuzer.@His true identity is@Al-Van Ranks of the Fury...
He infiltrated Ashurey for some purpose,@and once he'd achieved it, burned everything@down to silence any witnesses?
It's a bit of an odd story, though.@Even though this Al-Van was involved@in the Bellzelute's development...
...when Ashurey Kreuzer was attacked,@the unit itself and its test pilot@were somewhere else.
That's... maybe because I forced the@Bellzelute's test flight to start earlier@than scheduled.
Julian... no, Jua-Mu said as much.
Jua-Mu?
The White Horn pilot you fought@before the battle in Taipei?
That's right.@He was at Ashurey Kreuzer too...@I taught him to pilot humanoid weapons.
No wonder he was a natural.@I'm sure he... was already piloting Fury@machines before he ever met me.
He... deceived me too...
...Were there others at Ashurey Kreuzer@who might have been Fury?
...They all died. Jackie, so excited his@baby was on the way... Alice, who said she'd@gotten leave and was going home...
Volg, who'd just bought a house...@Gordon, who was going to propose to Mary...
This girl's parents, and Tenia's and Melua's...@They were all there, so...
This girl's parents, and Katia's and Melua's...@They were all there, so...
This girl's parents, and Katia's and Tenia's...@They were all there, so...
They weren't... like Al-Van and Jua-Mu...
(...I get wantin' to believe in your friends.)
I understand the broad outline.@I'll report this matter to Commander Miles@myself and ask for his judgment.
(Whatever the commander decides,@I won't stop fighting...)
(Not until I kill him... Al-Van... with my own hands...)
